mapper.select: SELECT a.*, p.real_name AS patient_name, p.phone AS patient_phone, dp.name AS department_name FROM appointment a JOIN patient p ON p.id = a.patient_id JOIN department dp ON dp.id = a.department_id WHERE a.doctor_id = #{doctorId} ORDER BY a.appointment_date, a.queue_no, a.id

SELECT a.*, p.real_name AS patient_name, p.phone AS patient_phone, p.gender AS patient_gender, p.birthday AS patient_birthday, dp.name AS department_name FROM appointment a JOIN patient p ON p.id = a.patient_id JOIN department dp ON dp.id = a.department_id WHERE a.id = #{appointmentId} AND a.doctor_id = #{doctorId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM department WHERE id = #{departmentId} AND status = 1 AND deleted = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE appointment SET appointment_date = #{appointmentDate}, period = #{period}, department_id = #{departmentId}, queue_no = #{queueNo}, status = #{status}, remark = #{remark} WHERE id = #{appointmentId}
UPDATE medical_visit SET visit_start_at = COALESCE(visit_start_at, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), status = 2 WHERE id = #{visitId}
UPDATE medical_visit SET visit_end_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, status = 3 WHERE id = #{visitId}
mapper.select: SELECT v.*, p.real_name AS patient_name, a.appointment_no FROM medical_visit v JOIN patient p ON p.id = v.patient_id JOIN appointment a ON a.id = v.appointment_id WHERE v.doctor_id = #{doctorId} ORDER BY v.created_at DESC

SELECT v.*, d.real_name AS doctor_name, a.appointment_no FROM medical_visit v JOIN doctor d ON d.id = v.doctor_id JOIN appointment a ON a.id = v.appointment_id WHERE v.patient_id = #{patientId} ORDER BY v.created_at DESC

SELECT v.*, p.real_name AS patient_name, d.real_name AS doctor_name, a.appointment_no FROM medical_visit v JOIN patient p ON p.id = v.patient_id JOIN doctor d ON d.id = v.doctor_id JOIN appointment a ON a.id = v.appointment_id WHERE v.id = #{visitId}
SELECT * FROM diagnosis_record WHERE visit_id = #{visitId} ORDER BY id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO prescription(visit_id, prescription_no, doctor_id, status) VALUES (#{visitId}, #{prescriptionNo}, #{doctorId}, 1)
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM prescription_item WHERE prescription_id = #{prescriptionId} ORDER BY id
mapper.update: UPDATE prescription SET status = 1, total_amount = 0.00 WHERE id = #{prescriptionId} AND status = 1
mapper.select: SELECT p.*, v.patient_id FROM prescription p JOIN medical_visit v ON v.id = p.visit_id WHERE p.id = #{prescriptionId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE prescription SET payment_status = 2, payment_no = #{paymentNo}, total_amount = #{amount}, paid_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{prescriptionId} AND payment_status = 1
mapper.select: SELECT i.id FROM prescription_item i JOIN prescription p ON p.id = i.prescription_id WHERE i.id = #{itemId} AND p.doctor_id = #{doctorId} AND p.status = 1 AND p.payment_status = 1
mapper.update: UPDATE prescription_item SET medicine_id = #{medicineId}, drug_name = #{drugName}, specification = #{specification}, dosage = #{dosage}, frequency = #{frequency}, days = #{days}, quantity = #{quantity}, unit_price = #{unitPrice}, remark = #{remark} WHERE id = #{itemId}
mapper.select: SELECT id, name, specification, unit_price, stock_quantity FROM medicine WHERE id = #{medicineId} AND status = 1
